summary: Backend-only unit testing of the email From-name feature. Mocked httpx.AsyncClient.post in email_service and captured the JSON body sent to Resend to verify the `from` header for every from_name scenario, the fallback, reply_to handling, and the _from_name_inscricao helper. Also verified all 4 admin_routes callsites are wired with the correct from_name. 14/14 pytest tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: File reference line numbers in the review request are slightly off (cadastro is admin_routes.py:436 not 413; inscricao is :421 not :428; reminders :2036/:2108), but the from_name wiring itself is 100% correct.
email_service.py (385 lines) and admin_routes.py (2116 lines) are large; admin_routes.py in particular exceeds the 700-line guideline and would benefit from modular splitting (not blocking).
verified_behaviours: send_email/try_send_email build body['from'] = '<display_name> <email_only>' — email extracted from RESEND_FROM whether plain ('contato@concursoamapa.online') or wrapped ('Name <...>').
from_name='Inscrição Polícia Militar PE' / 'Inscrição Bombeiro Militar PE' / 'Inscrição Pendente' all produce the exact expected 'Name <contato@concursoamapa.online>' header.
No from_name -> falls back to EMAIL_FROM_NAME ('Instituto AOCP').
_from_name_inscricao: PMPE->Policia, CBMPE->Bombeiro, cargo 'Corpo de Bombeiros'->Bombeiro (even with empty concurso), ''/'' -> Policia (default).
reply_to included only when EMAIL_REPLY_TO is a valid email; current placeholder env value ('não sei o que é isso') is correctly ignored (EMAIL_REPLY_TO is None).
try_send_email returns True on success (mocked 200) and False for invalid recipient.
admin_routes callsites: cadastro='Instituto AOCP', inscricao=_from_name_inscricao(concurso,cargo), ultimo dia & lembrete='Inscrição Pendente'.

Note pytest-asyncio is NOT installed here; async tests use a local @sync decorator wrapping asyncio.run. Resend BYOK is active (RESEND_API_KEY + RESEND_FROM='contato@concursoamapa.online'). rca of the issue: Original bug: RESEND_FROM held a bare email with no display-name, and the From header only applied EMAIL_FROM_NAME when RESEND_FROM used the '<email>' wrapped format, so all emails showed 'contato'. Fix (verified working): email_service now always extracts email_only from RESEND_FROM and builds '{display_name} <{email_only}>' using per-email-type from_name values passed from admin_routes. Confirmed via mocked Resend POST body assertions.
